title: Lunar Modulator settings
description: Device preferences, the four keys stage A1 settled (metronome and full velocity are the panel's own; count-in click and MIDI IN channel are kept for the stages that use them), kept in browser storage or the device's settings, never in a project or a link. Nothing here can enable MIDI out, pick a port or reach a device: MIDI out stays the user's opt-in on the page.
